follow-up time: From antenatal care at less than 24 weeks gestation to postnatal care
exposure: Uterine abnormality and/or current smoker of tobacco
Midwifery continuity of antenatal, intrapartum, and postnatal care (POPPIE group)
Previous short cervix or short cervix this pregnancy
outcome: Composite of appropriate and timely interventions for the prevention and/or management of preterm labor and birth
cohort: 334 pregnant women at increased risk of preterm birth attending antenatal care at less than 24 weeks' gestation in an inner-city maternity service in London (UK).
finding: While there was no significant difference in the primary composite outcome of appropriate and timely interventions for preterm labor and birth, infants in the POPPIE group had significantly higher rates of skin-to-skin contact and breastfeeding.
